{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:45.719
    | text      = So would you like a brief lesson in World War I?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:49.000
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:50.480
    | text      = And it's true that Britain was heavily threatened by the Austrian-Hungarian Empire.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:55.760
    | text      = Germany was just one piece of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:57.800
    | text      = And that they had surpassed America with inventions and technology and were taking over the world
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:03.000
    | text      = through business, not through military conquest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:07.079
    | text      = And so the Archduke, Franz Ferdinand, on the eve of World War I was assassinated, shot
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:12.719
    | text      = and hand-grenaded while driving in a motorcade.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:16.780
    | text      = And the war began in earnest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:19.920
    | text      = And then the Austrian-Hungarian Empire was broken up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:23.280
    | text      = Large pieces of it were given to Poland and France and many others.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:28.800
    | text      = Those were the complaints of the Germans and taxes were put on them and an incredible inflation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:35.519
    | text      = And they were in a depression much deeper than the depression we even saw in the United
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:40.880
    | text      = States.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:42.179
    | text      = And out of that angrier world came the National Socialist Workers Party that Hitler was a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:51.519
    | text      = young member of and that it was declassified after World War II that the British intelligence
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:57.019
    | text      = had been spying on and funding, not thinking it would take over later, but just that whatever
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:03.239
    | text      = group took over, they intended to basically be in the driver's seat with.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:07.239
    | text      = So British intelligence didn't control the Nazis, but they were there from their inception.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:12.719
    | text      = And if you want to actually study the history of that, it's there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:15.719
    | text      = The British intelligence wasn't guiding the Nazi party, especially in the earliest days.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:20.960
    | text      = But look, this honestly, this retelling of World War I even contradicts the version that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Let's see how Hitler's doing.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
